title: The River Stood Up for Me. (Part 1)
summary: Finn crosses a river to save his mother, and the water giant guarding the crossing reveals whom it has been waiting for.
frame_0: Finn stands with his back to the viewer on the dry riverbed between two walls of water. A foam-crowned blue giant looks down at him beside the raised bridge, with the king on the railing and the title above.
